# SCI-POINT To CAL/TolProj Envelope

Identity: `SCI-POINT_TO_CAL-TOLPROJ v0.1/r0.3`

POINT may publish the exact fitted-amplitude role, parent unit/calibration/
response, source association, source-reference identity, constraints,
uncertainty availability, method, support, and lifecycle when available.

CAL/TolProj exclusively owns admission for photometric reference or transfer,
reference-flux authority, transformations, comparison/aggregation, calibration
claims, and downstream products. POINT amplitude is not universal flux or
standalone absolute calibration. Fit completeness or QC eligibility does not
authorize photometric transfer.

The CAL/TolProj owner supplies the exact named-use profile. VAL registers and
evaluates it but authors neither its policy nor its scientific thresholds.
A diagnostic-display action under another use cannot establish photometric-
transfer eligibility.
